verdict.rationale: Convertio documents an Image Converter and claims support for more than 300 formats and 25,600 conversions, so basic image format conversion is evidenced. However, none of the named formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, SVG) is listed specifically. Quality, codec and similar settings are documented only for the video converter, which does not transfer to images. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of PNG/JPEG/WebP/HEIC/SVG support, documented image quality/size/compression controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
